bibliographic.title: Chamber of Echoes
bibliographic.author: Edorg Games
bibliographic.description:
In a city where identities are traded like software, you are a Data Archaeologist on the edge. Your mission: Scour the dangerous sectors of the old net and retrieve the Echo_Genesis fragment. But the deeper you dive towards the Signal Tower, the more the code starts to dissolve your own reality. Are you really who you think you are?

FEATURES:
Tactical Grid Movement: Navigate carefully through 4 sectors filled with corrupted data, hostile sentinels, and echoes of the past.
Reflex Hacking: A ruthless, time-based combat system. Be faster than the enemy firewalls or lose your memories.
Dynamic Black Market: Trade looted credits for illegal upgrades (HP, Timer, Shields) that increase in price with every purchase.
Story & Consequences: Collect rare memory fragments. Your choices and your fragment stash dictate which of the multiple endings you will reach.
V.E.R.A.: Your on-board AI companion – your only lifeline in the digital void.
